column1: # Numberings of the Bible other than the CEI 2008 (the text of this edition), and how a reference
# printed in one of them reads in the CEI. One table for the whole project (R2-21, revisione F1):
#   tools/ontologia/riferimenti.py  the rows with a "fonte": one reference as printed in the notes, margins
#                                   and introductions of the BJ (link id source, the reference as printed,
#                                   the n-th so printed in that source or 0 for all)
#   tools/ontologia/dufour.py       the rows of the scheme "dizionario": the older verse division of
#                                   Sirach 34-36 that the Dizionario di Teologia Biblica cites (the Bible de
#                                   Jérusalem of its French original, as the NAB 1970), verse by verse
# schema   volgata (the Vulgate), lxx (the Greek psalter: psalm numbers of the LXX, verse numbers
#          without the title), bj (the verse numbers of the BJ where they differ from the CEI),
# libro    the CEI siglum of the book the printed numbers belong to
# stampato the reference as printed (as riferimenti.py reads it: its "raw"), or a verse of the scheme
# cei      what it is in the CEI: a reference with its siglum (the link goes there, status resolved,
#          bj:interpretazione "numerazione: ..."); "=" the printed numbers are this same verse's
#          number in that scheme (status numbering, no link, like the bare numbers of the margins);
#          "—" no CEI counterpart (status unresolved, the reason said)
# fonte, n the source of the reference (riferimenti.py) and the n-th so printed there (0: all)
# motivo   why (the evidence: the text of the verses, the scheme)
# A row of riferimenti.py that matches no reference is an error (test_riferimenti.py).

column7: the Greek psalter: Ps 103 LXX is Ps 104; «In alto abitano gli uccelli del cielo» (Ps 104,12), the birds nesting in the mustard tree of Mt 13,32 (Ps 103,12 CEI is «quanto dista l'oriente dall'occidente»)
the Greek psalter: Ps 54 LXX is Ps 55, its v 20 without the title is v 21: «Ognuno ha steso la mano contro i suoi amici», the hand in the dish of Mt 26,23 (Ps 54 CEI has 9 verses)

verse numbered without the title: «θαυμαστὸς ὁ θεὸς ἐν τοῖς ἁγίοις αὐτοῦ» (Ps 67,36 LXX = Ps 68,36), «glorificato nei suoi santi … mirabile» of 2Ts 1,10 (Ps 68,35 CEI is «Riconoscete a Dio la sua potenza»)
the Greek psalter: Ps 9–10 are one psalm (Ps 9 LXX), its v 32 is Ps 10,11 «Dio dimentica, nasconde il volto, non vede più nulla», Ez 9,9 «il Signore non vede»
the margin prints the Vulgate number of this passage: Jdt 13,27–28 Vulgate is Achior's conversion, Gdt 14,5–10 (the bare numbers below it are the same run)
«Al v 16 corrispondono i vv 20–21 della volg.»: verses of the Vulgate, no CEI (Greek) counterpart
the note numbers Es 22 as the Vulgate (its 22,1 is the CEI 21,37): the civil and penal law ends at 22,19 «Colui che offre un sacrificio agli dèi … sarà votato allo sterminio»
the same numbering: the social morality, 22,20 «Non molesterai il forestiero» to 22,26
the same numbering: the rules for worship, 22,27 «Non bestemmierai Dio» to 22,30 (Es 22 CEI has 30 verses)
the Vulgate divides 2Mac 12 in 46 verses (its 46 «Sancta ergo et salubris est cogitatio…» is the end of the CEI 12,45; 2Mac 12 CEI has 45, and the BJ's own note says 12,38–45)
the Vulgate sets «Et cum haec dixisset, dimisit ecclesiam» as v 41; in the CEI it closes 19,40 («Detto questo, sciolse l'assemblea»); At 19 CEI has 40 verses
«per BJ: 36,29»: the number of this verse in the BJ (CEI 36,26 = BJ 36,29)
the BJ numbering of Sir 36 (CEI 36,26 = BJ 36,29, the note on 36,26; the chapter ends at 36,28 CEI = 36,31 BJ): the wife, 36,24–28
extra-canonical: the Greek Ps 151 («Il salterio greco conta 151 salmi»), not in the CEI canon
